caseNameFull: In re Tyler Arteaga v. California. In re Tyler

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir.; and

Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioners are allowed until October 27, 1997, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
